summary: As of November 2026, commercial LLM API pricing spans a roughly 100x range, from near $0.10/$0.50 per million tokens for lightweight tiers up to $10/$50 for frontier models, with vendors increasingly pricing by task tier rather than by a single flagship rate. Prompt caching, batch processing, and off-peak discounts are now standard levers that can substantially lower effective costs, and several vendors reprice entire requests once a prompt exceeds a token threshold (e.g., 128K or 272K). The lowest list price is rarely the lowest production cost once output volume, retries, and quality are factored in.

models.name: GPT-4o
models.notes: Batch API offers ~50% discount. Cached input priced at half of standard input. Widely used enterprise standard.

models.name: GPT-4o mini
models.notes: Low-cost tier for high-frequency tasks. Batch API discount available.

models.name: Claude Sonnet 4.6
models.notes: Prompt caching reads at ~10% of input cost; cache writes cost more. Batch processing offers ~50% discount.

models.name: Claude Haiku 4.5
models.notes: Fastest/cheapest Claude tier. Prompt caching and batch discounts available.

models.name: Gemini 2.5 Flash
models.notes: Free tier available via Google AI Studio with rate limits. Context caching discount available.

models.name: Gemini 2.5 Pro
models.notes: Input repriced for prompts over 200K ($2.50 input / $15 output). Free tier via AI Studio with limits. Context caching available.

models.name: o4-mini
models.notes: Cost-efficient reasoning model. Batch API discount available.

models.name: o3
models.notes: High-reasoning model; repriced lower in 2025. Batch API discount available.

models.name: Grok 4
models.notes: Cached input discounted. Higher rates apply for prompts beyond 128K.

models.name: Mistral Large
models.notes: Free experimental tier via La Plateforme with rate limits. Batch processing available.

models.name: Mistral Small
models.notes: Low-cost tier. Free experimental access via La Plateforme with rate limits.

models.name: Llama 3.3 70B (Together AI)
models.notes: Open-weight model hosted on Together AI. Flat per-token pricing. Free trial credits available.

models.name: Llama 3.3 70B (Groq)
models.notes: Ultra-low-latency inference on Groq LPU hardware. Free tier with rate limits.

models.name: Llama 3.1 405B (Fireworks)
models.notes: Largest open-weight Llama hosted on Fireworks. Flat pricing. Free credits on signup.

models.name: Command R+
models.notes: Free trial API keys available with rate limits. Strong RAG and tool-use focus.
